notes.title: Early September Dev Update 🚩
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Architects![/p][p]We’ve been busy behind the scenes, and it’s time to share some exciting updates with you. 

[i]Under Par Golf Architect[/i] is moving steadily into its [b]beta phase[/b] as we get closer to release, and we’ve also kicked off the [b]porting process[/b] to bring the game to more platforms.[/p][p][/p][p]One of the things we’re most excited about is the [b]demo[/b], which will be available very soon. If you haven’t already, make sure to [b]wishlist the game[/b]—that way you’ll get notified the moment the demo goes live!
[/p][p]Also, keep an eye on the [b]upcoming PC showcases[/b]. You might just spot [i]Under Par Golf Architect[/i] there, along with a couple of brand-new features we haven’t revealed before.
[/p][p]Gamescom was a truly [b]productive milestone[/b] for us—full of hands-on feedback, conversations, and new connections. We hope to get all the things sorted and turn those [i]Under Par[/i] opportunities into reality! 🤞
In the meantime, you can check out this [b]preview from Gamescom[/b]: [/p][list][*][p][url="https://insider-gaming.com/under-par-golf-architect-hands-on-preview/"]https://insider-gaming.com/under-par-golf-architect-hands-on-preview/[/url][/p][/*][/list][p]It’s a great hands-on impression of what we’ve been building.[/p][p]For our French-speaking community, you may want to read this as well: [/p][list][*][p][url="https://jv.jeuxonline.info/actualite/65415/gamescom-2025-under-golf-architect-tycoon-ancienne"]https://jv.jeuxonline.info/actualite/65415/gamescom-2025-under-golf-architect-tycoon-ancienne[/url]
[/p][/*][/list][p]Under Par was a show stopper at the italian booth 🤩[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524161/461897bea28b63e8c02ca1c23d5b1696c6e9c6ae.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We also want to give a huge shoutout to our [b]communities on [/b][url="https://www.reddit.com/r/underpargame/"]Reddit [/url][b]and [/b][url="https://discord.gg/6BwvsyWDBZ"]Discord[/url]. You’ve been sharing ideas, feedback, and feature suggestions—and while we can’t promise everything will make it into the game, please know we’re reading and discussing all of it. If you’d like to be part of shaping the future of [i]Under Par Golf Architect[/i], we’d love to see you there too!
[/p][p]Thanks again for all your support—it means the world to us. 
We can’t wait to share more and see the creative courses you’ll design when the demo drops!

[/p][p]– The Broken Arms Games Team[/p]

notes.title: ⛳ July Dev Blog: Managing Your Golf Club
notes.notes:
[h2][b]🏠 Start with the Basics
[/b][/h2][p][b]Clubhouse
[/b] The clubhouse is the heart of your resort. It’s where golfers relax, grab a drink, and share stories after a round. Make sure it’s easy to access and leaves a strong first impression.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524161/27f9bab75c6eb8efeb488b176ae8cc99a24c2aa0.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Entrance Gate
[/b] Only open the entrance once your course is ready. A poorly prepared course can damage your reputation and drive players away before your club even gets started.[/p][p][b]Paths and Flow
[/b] Smooth, logical paths between holes help your golfers move comfortably through the course. Good flow avoids confusion and improves the overall experience.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🛠️ Key Structures That Make a Difference
[/b][/h2][p]Beyond the layout, the buildings you place shape the identity of your club and add value for your guests:[/p][p][b]Bar and Restaurant
[/b] After a long day on the fairway, a cozy bar or a well-stocked restaurant is the perfect place to wind down. These buildings boost satisfaction and also generate useful extra income.[/p][p][b]Pool and Recreation Areas
[/b] Not all guests come just for golf. Pools, tennis courts, and other amenities turn your club into a full-fledged resort that’s welcoming to families and casual visitors alike.[/p][p][b]Training Zones
[/b] Driving ranges and putting areas are a must for golfers looking to improve. These facilities keep players coming back to sharpen their skills and challenge your course.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524161/ad4e44eb7d2e139bd8b5027376fad7ac36063ae2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🌟 Catering to VIP Golfers[/b][/h2][p]VIP golfers aren’t just high-paying members — they’re special characters with [b]unique backstories[/b] and [b]missions[/b] to offer. These missions help you [b]advance your career[/b] and unlock new opportunities for your club. Treating them well means more than luxury — it means engaging with the heart of the game’s progression.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]💰 Subscriptions: A Steady Income Source
[/b][/h2][p]Clicking on a golfer lets you view their personal [b]requirements[/b] — fulfill them, and they may [b]become a subscriber[/b] to your club. Understanding what each golfer wants is key to growing a loyal base and securing long-term income.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524161/df16b48da006551b83d2c7f1d21e87cead8d2249.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]💡 Smart Financial Management
[/b][/h2][p]Every new building, from training zones to luxury pools, is an investment. Managing your club’s budget means balancing spending with income from subscriptions. Growth is good—but only when it’s sustainable.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524161/1768f2b24801bd23e6aa6e0d4ce6f94361956d5d.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🏆 In Summary: Manage with Strategy[/b][/h2][p][b]Key Tips for Success:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Build essential structures like bars, restaurants, pools, and training zones to enhance the golfer experience and increase revenue. [/p][/*][*][p]Hire the right staff to ensure excellent service and create a welcoming atmosphere. [/p][/*][*][p]Balance your budget by investing wisely and keeping your subscriber base strong. [/p][/*][*][p]Maintain golfer loyalty by [b]meeting their individual needs[/b] and creating a club that feels like home. [/p][/*][/list][p]With some thoughtful planning and care, your golf club will become the ultimate destination — both for casual players and those with bigger dreams.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524161/4ed1bc209427d58855ebdab3829085f5f365d99c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3] Last but not least, if you have been brave enough to read until here we have an announcement to make: [u]a new playtest is coming our way[/u], next week we will share more about it but for the moment just mark this date in your calendar, 🏌️ [b]July 30th we'll see each other on the green 🏌️[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Talk soon,
Broken Arms Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: 🏌️‍♂️ June Dev Blog: The Anatomy of a Golf Hole
notes.notes:
[p]In [i]Under Par Golf Architect[/i], your job is to design golf holes that are played, judged, and remembered by golfers. Every choice you make—tee placement, hazard design, green shape—directly affects how players experience difficulty, strategy, and fun.[/p][p]Let’s break down the four key components of a golf hole—and how they work together to shape each round.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]1. 🟩 Tee Box – The Opening Statement[/b][/h2][p][b]Purpose
[/b]The tee box defines the starting point and sets the tone for the entire hole. It influences how players read the landscape and plan their opening shot.[/p][p][b]Design Tips[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Orientation[/b]: Angle and position the tee to frame the fairway and suggest a natural line of play.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Elevation & Visibility[/b]: Slightly raised tees improve sightlines and help golfers assess distance and danger.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Scalability[/b]: Even with a single tee, thoughtful placement leaves room for varied course difficulty later on.[/p][/*][/list][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524161/8ecb5459a2262ed5e9fdb9dec128a37111c9dda0.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]2. 🌳 Fairway – The Strategic Corridor[/b][/h2][p][b]Purpose
[/b]The fairway is the main path from tee to green. Its shape and flow guide shot choices and define much of the hole’s personality.[/p][p][b]Design Tips[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Width & Shape[/b]: Wider fairways are forgiving; narrow or curved ones demand precision. Use shape to encourage strategic decisions.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Landing Zones[/b]: Include curves, elevation shifts, or natural obstacles that guide players through meaningful shot choices.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Waypoint Control[/b]: You can modify the fairway’s route by adjusting its waypoints, allowing you to bend and shape the hole exactly how you want. Doglegs, S-curves, and unconventional paths are fully possible, giving you the creative freedom to break away from traditional layouts. [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Natural Flow[/b]: A fairway that blends into the environment creates a more believable and enjoyable experience.  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524161/1624acf6435096e7e8490b7a010383546aac7063.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]3. 🏖️ Hazards – Risk and Reward[/b][/h2][p][b]Purpose
[/b]Hazards introduce risk and decision-making. They challenge players to weigh bold plays against safer routes.[/p][p][b]Design Tips[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Placement[/b]: Position bunkers and rough near landing zones or greens to force thoughtful play.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Water Hazards[/b]: Visually striking and strategically interesting, but best used sparingly.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Rough & Boundaries[/b]: Use trees, bushes, and thick rough to define the fairway and shape consequences.
[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524161/5714fa7cb51b09f0406dd123c9713dc32aa0c72f.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]4. 🌱 Green – The Destination[/b][/h2][p][b]Purpose
[/b]The green is where every hole ends—and where precision is most important.[/p][p][b]Design Tips[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Size & Shape[/b]: Larger greens offer forgiveness; smaller or more contoured greens demand finesse.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Surroundings[/b]: Use flanking bunkers, runoff zones, and gentle slopes to shape approaches. [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Approach Angles[/b]: Always consider how players will access the green—avoid making it feel unfair or overly tight.[/p][/*][/list][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524161/2cbc57624a6b799a0853c392882f6eaa75614222.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]⛳ Shape the land, guide the play, and let your course speak for itself ⛳


Stay creative
Broken Arms Games team
[/b][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524161/715a0fb5b077b83f34ffc43798e89352eb64d0c2.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524161/f0d7d1c117cd9fd6ac2ee11468eba8dfac89896a.png"][/img][/url][b]
[/b][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: 🏌️ First Swing at Under Par Golf Architect – Playtest Starts June 6!
notes.notes:
Hey architects!
We have some exciting news to share with you from the team here at Broken Arms Games!
We’re thrilled to announce that the first-ever open playtest for our upcoming golf club management sim, Under Par Golf Architect, is just around the corner! [b]The playtest will be open to all players on Steam from June 6 to June 11, 2025 [/b]– and you’re all invited to jump in, start building, and help us shape the future of the game.

During this playtest, you’ll get hands-on access to the course creation tools – no golf gameplay just yet – so we can focus on refining the core building experience with your help.

[h2]📺 Watch Under Par in the Future Games Show![/h2]

We’re also super proud to share that Under Par: Golf Architect will be part of the Future Games Show: Summer Showcase!
📅 Saturday, June 7 🕐 1 PM PT | 🕓 4 PM ET | 🕘 9 PM BST | 🕙 10 PM CEST

[h2]✅ How to Join the Playtest[/h2]

Getting in is easy – no key required! on Friday 6th when the playtest will be live you only have to:
[list]
[*] Head to the Steam page
[*] Click “Request Access”
[*] Download the build 
[/list]

[h2]💬 Help Us Build the Future[/h2]

Your feedback means everything to us. Here’s how you can help:
[list]
[*] Share your feedback and bug reports using this form: 📝 https://forms.gle/Me7xzNBCKQDHeRjV7
[*] Wishlist the game on Steam to stay in the loop
[*] Join our [url=https://discord.gg/6BwvsyWDBZ]Discord [/url]community to chat with us and meet other builders
[/list]

[h2]❓ FAQ[/h2]

[h3]🈯 What languages are available in the playtest?[/h3]
 English, German, French, Spanish, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified), and Chinese (Traditional)
[h3]📹 Can I stream or make a video based on this build?[/h3]
 Yes! We’d love that. Please just mention that this is a Playtest version and still a work in progress. And if you’re streaming, tag us on social media – we’d love to share your work!
[h3]🧪 Will there be more Playtests or a demo in the future?[/h3]
 We definitely plan to launch a demo version later on and will share any updates about future Playtests on our social channels.
[h3]🎮 Is the Playtest playable on Steam Deck?[/h3]
 Yes! We’ve tested it on Steam Deck and it’s playable. If you find any bugs, please report them here.
[h3]🔧 Is this Playtest build representative of the final version?[/h3]
 This is still a work in progress, and some things may change based on your feedback. That said, the core experience you see here will be very close to what we’re planning for launch.

We can’t wait to see what you build!
 Thanks again for being part of this journey 💚⛳
 — The Broken Arms Games Team

notes.title: May Dev blog - Golfers
notes.notes:
Hello Fellow Architects,

We wanted to share some exciting progress and insights into the development of Under Par Golf Architect. Here's what's been happening behind the scenes:


[h1]🗓️ Upcoming Beta Test and Steam Events[/h1]

We're actively exploring opportunities to participate in some major Steam events at the end of May, which could be the perfect stage for our first Beta Test session. Stay tuned – we might have some thrilling news to share as early as next week!

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]🎵 Soundtrack Sneak Peek[/h1]

We're also deep into crafting the game's original soundtrack. Music is a huge part of setting the tone for Under Par Golf Architect, and we'd love to give you a sneak peek at one of our main themes:

[previewyoutube=g8Yu5ASLqcA;full][previewyoutube=g8Yu5ASLqcA;leftthumb]🎧 [Listen Now](LINK YOUTUBE)[/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]🌿 Recreating Amen Corner in Under Par Golf Architect[/h1]

One of the most iconic sections in the world of golf is Amen Corner. We took on the challenge of bringing this legendary sequence to life within the game. Check out a first look at how we're capturing its atmosphere:
[previewyoutube=8lSXARE3xUw;full][previewyoutube=8lSXARE3xUw;leftthumb]🎥 [Preview the Recreation](YOUTUBE LINK)[/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h2]⛳ In-Depth Gameplay Mechanics[/h2]

This time, we want to dive a little deeper into the heart of the game – Golfers!

Golfers are the lifeblood of your course, and understanding their behavior is key to building a thriving club. Let's break it down:

[h3]🏃 Visitors[/h3]
Every great club starts with curious visitors. If they enjoy their first experience, they might just become full-fledged members.

[h3]👥 Members[/h3]
Once they commit, members will return as often as your course can keep them entertained. They are your bread and butter, so make sure they have a great time!

[h3]💎 Special Visitors / V.I.P.s[/h3]
These are unique, eccentric characters with special requests. Earning their loyalty won't be easy, but the rewards are worth it. Keep an eye on these characters – they can be game-changers for your club.

[h3]🎯 Golfer Stats[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524161/64c9602aab4e9a986d3465d566fefcd9ef16aaae.png[/img]

Golfers come with a mix of personal needs and competitive skills that you must balance:

Basic Needs (Management Focus)

[list]
[*]     Hunger
[*]     Thirst
[*]     Energy
[*]     Restroom
[*]     Wishes
[/list]

Competitive Skills (Design Focus)

[list]
 [*]     Power – How far a golfer can drive the ball
 [*]     Accuracy – The ability to aim precisely
 [*]     Imagination – Creative problem-solving when faced with tricky terrains
 [/list]

To keep your golfers coming back, you’ll need to create courses that challenge their skills without overwhelming them. Design holes that test different abilities, and you'll keep your course's "fun rating" high – a key to long-term success!

Thanks for following our journey. Your support means the world to us, and we can't wait to share even more exciting updates soon!

See you on the green,

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524161/715a0fb5b077b83f34ffc43798e89352eb64d0c2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524161/f0d7d1c117cd9fd6ac2ee11468eba8dfac89896a.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Under Par Golf Architect - New Game Wishlist Now
notes.notes:
Broken Arms Games is thrilled to announce “Under Par Golf Architect” their new upcoming game in which players can step into the shoes of a golf architect as they build and manage their golfing paradise! 
[b]Wishlist now![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2928410/Under_Par_Golf_Architect/

Sharpen your strategy by designing incredible courses to challenge the most demanding golfers and watch your club flourish as you attract VIP players, hire quirky staff and hold prestigious tournaments.
Design world-class golf courses by terraforming rough wasteland into lush fairways for smooth drives and pristine greens to ensure a true roll for every putt. Every course you create is a masterpiece waiting to be explored.

[previewyoutube=xR0BmvgbMVs;full][/previewyoutube]

Build and maintain your golfing paradise to keep your members happy and entertained with bars, pools, restaurants and training facilities. Golfer membership will ensure your profit and the growth of your first-class resort.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524161/aa70b1f644e3c5f22e4c209b77aeb83953e2d923.png[/img]

Play your own course and test your skills against challenging layouts and unpredictable hazards, from towering trees to treacherous water features. Don’t want to play but still like to experience the challenges of your design? Click on the teeing area to simulate the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524161/ad4f0284d9f8a0acfb785c62b35d2d8a415cb548.png[/img]

Customize your golf course across a range of different biomes, from bustling cities to some of the most remote regions in the world. Experiment with different landscaping elements to evoke a variety of atmospheres, from classic elegance to modern extravagance. VIP golfers love exclusitìvity; if they can only reach your course by helicopter they’ll do it, but it needs to be worth their while - fine-tune every detail to suit their preferences and taste!

Stay up to date with all the latest news on Under Par Golf Architect joining our Discord Server, visit the official website www.underpargame.com, and follow us on social media to stay up to date..
